tools.name: list_smart_links
tools.title: List smart links
tools.description: List the signed-in user's smart links with their slug, destination, short URL and click count.

search.description: Optional text filter on slug, title or destination.

limit.description: Maximum number of links to return.

tools.name: create_smart_link
tools.title: Create smart link
tools.description: Create a short smart link for the signed-in user, optionally gated behind a YouTube action before the destination unlocks.

destinationUrl.description: Where the visitor lands after unlocking.

title.description: Title shown on the unlock page.

description.description: Short description shown on the unlock page.

youtubeVideoId.description: YouTube video ID to require watching before the link unlocks.

youtubeChannelId.description: YouTube channel ID to require subscribing to before the link unlocks.

tools.name: get_link_analytics
tools.title: Get link analytics
tools.description: Summarize click performance across the signed-in user's smart links, with a ranked list of top performers.

top.description: How many top links to include.

tools.name: delete_smart_link
tools.title: Delete smart link
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in user's smart links by its slug.

slug.description: Slug of the smart link to delete.
